General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These Suzuki OEM parts fasten directly above the passengers and drivers doors

Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Door Rail – LH
Qty 1 – Door Rail – RH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
